_comment: Isolation and spacing requirements for Andiron. tools/check/sanity.py verifies that heating-controller.kicad_dru encodes each rule with at least this value, so DRC enforces them on every run. Basis: IEC 62368-1 / 60730-1, 230 V mains, OVC II (2.5 kV impulse), pollution degree 2, material group IIIb assumed.

rules.basis: reinforced 3.0 mm required; 6.4 mm design floor
reinforced 5.0 mm required (PD2, IIIb); 6.4 mm design floor
raw live terminal nets before any resistor
chain nodes, ~40 V across one 22 k resistor
mains copper away from the board edge and enclosure
fault current until the 3 A fuse clears
